meta.title: fix: enhance API Keys component with loading indicators and performance optimizations
meta.body_summary: Add loading indicators, query timeout (10s), LRU cache (max 1000 entries), and improved error handling with toasts to the API Keys component.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added UI and data-access optimizations; maintainer closed PR as not needed, with no performance evidence required.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 150 changed lines in a single file, this is a small edit by absolute volume. Despite its modest size, the PR was rejected because the maintainer deemed the feature unnecessary, not for technical reasons.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer riderx closed the PR with the comment 'not needed', indicating that the performance enhancements were not aligned with current project priorities.
review_details.performance_claim: Improve API Keys component responsiveness with loading states, DB query timeout, LRU cache for org/app names, and centralized error handling with toasts.
review_details.rejection_signals: Single comment 'not needed' from maintainer, no further discussion; PR closed without merge.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Devin proposed a set of well-structured performance optimizations but failed to align with maintainer needs, resulting in rejection as an unnecessary change.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer read the PR description and closed as not needed; no detailed code review was performed.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after metrics, benchmark, or profiling data were provided or requested; only narrative claims.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR was closed without merge after maintainer judged the feature unnecessary.

core_change_summary.description: In src/components/ApiKeys.vue, added loading spinners and disabled states for async operations, wrapped DB queries with a 10-second timeout utility, implemented an LRU cache (max 1000 entries) for organization/app names, and centralized error handling with toast notifications.
change_trajectory: Single commit (6ae7815) introduced all performance and UX enhancements.
Maintainer closed PR approximately 31 hours later with comment 'not needed'.
After closure, Devin bot posted a detailed breakdown of the changes (post-mortem).
